title: Preventing Falls Through Skylights and Holes
summary: From 2011 to 2016, 165 workers died after falling through a skylight or hole. Guard or cover every skylight and hole, and never sit, step, or lean on a skylight.
talking_points: 165 workers died after falling through a skylight or hole from 2011 to 2016.
Never sit, step on, or lean against a skylight.
Guard or cover any existing skylights.
If you create, uncover, or notice a hole, guard it or cover it securely, and label the cover "hole" or "cover."
Always use one of these: covers or screens, railings or guardrails, or a personal fall arrest system such as a full-body harness.
Good practice: tell the crew and the supervisor when you find a hole or skylight that is not protected, so it is fixed before anyone works near it.
site_hazards_to_check: Skylights with no cover, screen, or guardrail
Holes with no cover or guardrail
Covers that are not marked "hole" or "cover"
Covers that are loose or not secured
Openings created or uncovered during the job and left unprotected
discussion_questions: Where are the skylights and holes on this roof, and what is protecting each one?
Who will guard or cover any new hole we open today?
What will you do if you see someone stand on or lean against a skylight?
